general: 3D view: the screenshot test has no OpenGL, so the app's 3D view is drawn as a flat sketch of the grids; on the phone it is the real view. v69 draws its ground grid with a shader (minor and major lines); the app draws grid lines in v69's major colour (0x434a56 dark / 0xa3abb8 light). The default camera differs (S5).

Fonts: both sides use Roboto, as on the phone (Android Chrome draws v69 in Roboto). The UI golden renders v69 with the Roboto files Robolectric ships (tools/golden/ui_fonts.py, phone-fonts.conf) and the app lays text out with linear advances (TextMotion.Animated), so words are as wide as in v69. The emoji glyphs (🗑, 🚶) still look different in the screenshots.

System bars: the v69 shots are Chrome's page area (no status / navigation bar). The app draws edge to edge (targetSdk 35) and pads every bar, panel, sheet, dialog, menu and toast with the phone's insets, so on a phone they sit below the status bar and above the navigation bar.
The red 'DEV · license skipped' badge belongs to the owner's DEV copy of v69 and is not in the app.
Toasts: v69 fades and slides them in (0.2 s); the app shows and hides them without the animation.
Theme override: v69 never sets data-theme (it always follows the phone); the app keeps that as the default and adds a choice in About (as the phone / dark / light).
01_main: v69 shows the engine toast 'Exact engine ready · new shapes are exact' at start; the app has no such engine step.
The ⋮ menu has one more item in the app: 'About SolidSketch Steel' (version, data, theme, debug overlay).
02_steel_grid: v69 adds a weight line under the Steel panel for a selected part (v66 Tekla weights); it comes with Tekla weights (S11).
Grid level lines are dashed in v69 and solid in the app (S5 decision).
04_catalog: The catalog's footer (component count, Symbols, Close) stays at the bottom of the sheet in the app, and the search at the top; in v69 the whole sheet scrolls, so they are at the end of the 252-item list (S9b decision, owner: Symbols / Close were hidden). The rows start where v69's do; the last two rows v69 shows on the first screen are behind the footer in the app (scroll to see them).
05_dialog_t144: In dark mode v69 keeps the dialog pane's text at #1d2330 on the #2b3038 pane (barely readable); the app copies this exactly.

Preset list and preset name: on a phone v69's top bar is wider than the screen, so the list (it shows only its arrow) and the name box shrink to 18 px each; the app copies this (UI golden; see PROGRESS.md, decisions).
07_menu: v69's menu has no height limit and runs under the Steel panel or off the screen on a phone; the app's menu stays inside the screen and scrolls.
'Exact engine (beta)' shows v69's state after its engine loaded ('on'); the app has no such switch yet (it says it comes later).
